## What Customers Built, and What Changed

Architecture & Engineering

### Engineering Firm Cuts Site Due-Diligence Research by 90%

#### Problem

Researching a site's building codes and jurisdiction rules took half a workday per site.

#### Solution

A research workflow looks up the code requirements on the web and fills in the due-diligence documents.

#### Result

About 90% less labor per site: a half-day task reduced to minutes.

- AI Workflows
- Abacus AI Agent
- DataLLM
- Document retrieval

Software

1.5Mleads scored every day

3regions scored daily: APAC, EMEA and AMER

~10Kpriority leads a day explained in plain language

### Design Software Company Scores 1.5M Leads a Day Across Three Regions

#### Problem

Lead volumes were too large to prioritize by hand.

#### Solution

A daily pipeline scores every lead, routes high-value accounts into nurture sequences and explains each priority score to the rep.

#### Result

1.5M leads scored a day across three regions, with plain-language reasons for ~10K priority leads.

- Predictive ML
- Batch predictions
- Feature groups
- Model explainability

Private Equity

95⁠–⁠99%extraction accuracy across fund documents

100K+investment documents processed

3document vaults connected, with no manual transfers

### Private Equity Firm Extracts Fund KPIs from 100K+ Documents

#### Problem

Fund metrics sat in 100,000+ documents across three vaults, reviewed entirely by hand.

#### Solution

A multi-model pipeline extracts the metrics, resolves duplicates and conflicts, and badges each critical KPI with its confidence.

#### Result

95⁠–⁠99% extraction accuracy, replacing the manual review.

- Multi-model pipelines
- Document retrieval
- Connectors

AI Workflows

## Workflows That Do the Work

Pipelines that take in the documents and data a team handles every day and hand back finished, checked work.

- 1,000sof drawings processed every day

Manufacturing

### Manufacturer Matches Thousands of Technical Drawings to Suppliers Every Day





#### Problem



The supply chain team had to classify thousands of technical drawings, extract their attributes and find qualified suppliers, with heavy manual review.



#### Solution



A multimodal workflow extracts trade codes, taxonomy and OEM details from each drawing in parallel, and a bot matches each drawing to qualified suppliers.



#### Result



Thousands of drawings are processed daily on a pipeline built for tens of thousands a day, with much less manual classification.





  - AI Workflows
  - Custom chatbots
  - Predictive ML

- 200+record categories, sorted and filed automatically

Healthcare

### Healthcare Provider Stops Sorting Patient Records by Hand





#### Problem



Incoming medical records were sorted and routed by hand before a physician could see them.



#### Solution



An LLM pipeline classifies each record, scores its confidence and sends uncertain ones to a person, writes a patient summary and files the record into the EHR.



#### Result



Records are sorted into 200+ categories and filed without manual routing, and the physician is alerted when new ones arrive.





  - AI Workflows
  - LLM pipelines
  - EHR integration

- 7+rule categories checked on every asset

Media & Marketing

### Marketing Agency Automates Quality Checks on Studio Artwork





#### Problem



Every poster and banner the agency makes for major film and TV studios must pass strict guideline checks, and its open-source QA model was slow.



#### Solution



A multimodal workflow checks typography, credit sizing, logo copyright and wild-posting rules, behind a web app where designers upload a ZIP of assets.



#### Result



Checks across 7+ rule categories run in one workflow, faster than the old model, with per-image results and spreadsheet export.





  - AI Workflows
  - Abacus AI Agent
  - Custom apps

- ~1,000active users, including ~300 developers

Business Software

### Business Software Provider Puts Workflow Automation in the Hands of ~1,000 Employees





#### Problem



Business units and IT wanted to automate their workflows and build internal tools without waiting for engineering resources.



#### Solution



Business users build workflows and internal tools with the AI agent, Scheduled Tasks run them on a recurring cadence, and ~300 developers use CodeLLM.



#### Result



About 1,000 people use the platform, 350+ have attended enablement sessions, and recurring processes run on schedule without manual work.





  - Abacus AI Agent
  - Scheduled Tasks
  - CodeLLM

Apps & agents

## From Prompt to Production App

Teams describe the internal app or agent they need and build it on Abacus.AI, instead of buying another tool.

- 30⁠–⁠60receipts per report, audited by the agent

Technology

### Fortune 500 Data Company Hands Expense Audits to an AI Agent





#### Problem



Auditing expense reports of 30⁠–⁠60 receipts each against policy was time-consuming manual work.



#### Solution



An agent reads every receipt, validates it against policy rules and sends the approval or rejection email. It shipped from development to production with user acceptance sign-off.



#### Result



Expense audits run automatically, reducing the manual review burden, and a second phase extends the agent to complex and edge-case categories.





  - Abacus AI Agent
  - LLM extraction
  - Private VPC

- 170 pagesof penetration testing, passed

Food & Agriculture

### Global Agri-Food Company Lets Non-Engineers Build Internal Apps





#### Problem



Business teams needed internal tools and data answers without waiting on engineers or writing SQL.



#### Solution



Employees describe the app they need and the AI agent builds it. Developers use CodeLLM, and business users query Snowflake and Athena in plain English.



#### Result



Non-engineers build production-grade internal tools that users rate above Microsoft Copilot, on a platform that passed a 170-page penetration test.





  - Abacus AI Agent
  - CodeLLM
  - Data connectors

- Hours → Minsfor client-ready reports

Public Relations

### PR Agency Replaces Manual Coverage Tracking with Agents





#### Problem



Team members spent hours every week searching the web for press placements and assembling client reports by hand in a paid reporting tool.



#### Solution



A web-search agent finds and formats press placements with their audience data, another agent pulls ad spend month over month, and a dashboard reports social reach.



#### Result



Client-ready reports take minutes instead of hours, the reporting tool subscription is gone, and the coverage skill is shared by every client team.





  - Abacus AI Agent
  - Skills
  - Dashboards

- 2,000seats across its TV stations

Broadcast Media

### Broadcaster Rolls Out AI Research to 2,000 Seats Across Its TV Stations





#### Problem



Researching stories and preparing broadcast segments took journalists and producers significant manual effort.



#### Solution



An AI agent researches everything from quick fact-checks to in-depth stories, a pipeline automates segment research, and a workflow resizes photos for broadcast and digital.



#### Result



Journalists spend less time on research, ad production moves faster, and about 600 million tokens a month run across 2,000 seats.





  - Abacus AI Agent
  - AI Workflows
  - Custom chatbots

AI assistants

## Assistants That Know Your Business

Assistants grounded in a company's own procedures, documents and data, with the governance IT teams need.

- 1,000+employees registered, 100⁠–⁠120 active each day

Banking

### Community Bank Gives Branch Staff an Assistant for Bank Procedures





#### Problem



Branch staff needed quick, correct answers on procedures while serving customers, from address changes to token resets and debit card orders.



#### Solution



An assistant grounded in the bank's procedures and policies, tailored to retail, commercial and loan administration staff, with weekly adoption reports sent automatically.



#### Result



1,000+ employees registered and 100⁠–⁠120 use it every day, one of the fastest adoption ramps on the platform.





  - ChatLLM Enterprise
  - Custom chatbots
  - Document retrieval

- 150⁠–⁠200employees onboarded every week

Airline

### Airline Onboards 150⁠–⁠200 Employees a Week Through a Training Assistant





#### Problem



An airline rolling AI out to its whole workforce needed every employee trained before getting access.



#### Solution



A training assistant with Microsoft Entra sign-in gates platform access until training is done, and a Microsoft Teams chatbot reaches employees not yet onboarded.



#### Result



Employees join in weekly cohorts of 150⁠–⁠200, trained before they get access, and sales teams produce their weekly channel reports themselves in plain language.





  - Custom chatbots
  - Microsoft Teams
  - DataLLM

- ~566active users of 691 invited, across 80 countries

Commercial Services

### Global Services Company Rolls Out AI Assistants Across 80 Countries





#### Problem



A 60,000-person company in 80 countries needed to extend advanced AI and agents to its workforce cost-effectively.



#### Solution



The AI super assistant is rolling out region by region, staff use the AI agent for company research and automation, and an HR portal lets employees use internal chatbots without a full license.



#### Result



Adoption is strong in Europe and expanding into Asia-Pacific, and Abacus.AI is now the designated platform for advanced AI use cases.





  - ChatLLM
  - Abacus AI Agent
  - Custom chatbots

- 150+users, with real-time data-loss alerts

Alternative Investments

### Investment Firm Watches Its AI Assistant for Data Leaks in Real Time





#### Problem



A global investment firm with strict security and compliance rules needed to roll out an AI assistant without risking data leaving the firm.



#### Solution



A monitoring pipeline built on Abacus.AI flags policy violations, such as emails to external domains, unauthorized MCP connections and risky conversations, and alerts IT security in real time.



#### Result



The assistant reached 150+ people across investment and operations teams, and every policy violation reaches IT security as it happens.





  - Abacus AI Agent
  - MCP connectors
  - Audit logs

Predictive models

## Models That Predict and Decide

Models trained on a company's own data that take over classification and pricing decisions.

- 80%less manual processing time

Financial Services

### Lender Cuts Manual Industry Classification Time by 80%





#### Problem



Assigning industry (SIC) codes to small and medium-sized businesses by hand was slow, error-prone and held up lending.



#### Solution



A combination of ChatLLM, generative AI and ML determines the SIC code from business information across sources, in batches.



#### Result



Manual processing time dropped by 80%, with over 85% classification accuracy.





  - Predictive ML
  - ChatLLM

- 10%higher net profit per guest

Retail

### Retailer Raises Net Profit per Guest by 10% with Price Optimization





#### Problem



The retailer struggled to find the ideal price point for its products.



#### Solution



A regression model deduces each product's price sensitivity and ideal price point, so prices can be tested without losing customers.



#### Result



Net profit per guest rose 10%, with 90% accuracy in price-sensitivity estimates.





  - Predictive ML
  - Optimization
